messages:
maya: Quick preflight — change window starts in ~45m. Can everyone ack a short checklist so we can open the window? I put the items we need below, comment if anything missing.

maya: Checklist (please reply with ✅/❌ or short note):
1) Release notes published internally + external blurb ✅/❌
2) Canary health (latency, errors) ✅/❌
3) Version pins for runtime/model set and pushed ✅/❌
4) Rollback plan & owners ✅/❌
5) DB/Schema migration window confirmed (if any) ✅/❌
6) Dashboards + alerts validated ✅/❌
7) Oncall / paging & rotation set for the window ✅/❌
8) Docs/snippets updated (SDK, examples) ✅/❌

sebastian: Acked — I'll take pins and rollback owner. Canary looked clean on my run: p95 latency +0ms, no 5xx. I'll push the pin in ~15m.

sebastian: Pin I plan to apply (runtime + model routing):
```
# runtime pin (k8s)
kubectl set image deployment/llm-runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 --record
# model traffic split (console/API)
POST /api/traffic-split {"model":"redwood/gold-2026","weight":1.0}
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete — 9/9 pods ready, 0 x 5xx in the last 10m, avg token latency 14ms. Link: https://ci.redwood/integrations/deploys/1790456

liam: Adding rollback criteria: if error rate >0.8% OR latency p95 increases by >40% sustained over 5m, we rollback to v2.3.0. Rollback steps (short):
- sebastian triggers rollback tag: release/1790456-rollback
- deploy-bot runs: kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-runtime --to-revision=<prev>
- Verify canary + metrics 5m
- If DB migration happened, follow migration rollback checklist (notify @db-team)

dana: Release notes are live internally at https://confluence.redwood/release/1790456 and external blurb drafted for docs. Noted one minor breaking change in embeddings API (backwards-compatible with shim). I'll post the consumer note in #customer-updates after pin.

anita: Change freeze starts at 22:00 UTC for this window. Exceptions require exec approval from @sebastian or @maya. Oncall rotation is set — @liam you are primary, @carol backup.

carol: Observability: created dashboard `release/1790456` and two alerts: high-token-rate (>= 2x baseline for 3m) and p95-latency (> 50ms for 5m). I also added a temporary trace-sampling rule for this window. Docs snippets updated in SDK repo (PR #382).

sebastian: Pin applied to runtime and traffic split. Monitoring alert thresholds set as discussed.

maya: Great — final check: any pending DB work?

sebastian: No DB migrations in this release. Safe.

liam: I'm on pager. I'll start a short watch with 1st check @ +2m after open, then every 5m for 30m. Rollback action if criteria tripped.

maya: OK opening change window at 22:00 UTC. Please monitor #incidents and this thread. If you see anything odd, call the rollback, don't hesitate. GLHF :rocket:

deploy-bot: Change window opened by maya at 22:00 UTC. Canary status snapshot: healthy.

maya: Thanks team — recording the approvals: sebastian (pin), dana (notes), carol (obs), liam (oncall), anita (freeze).

carol: Quick heads-up — I'll escalate to SRE if the high-token-rate alert fires twice in 10m.

sebastian: If we need to rollback I’ll coordinate and post step-by-step.

maya: Closing preflight. I'll keep the thread as source of truth for decisions/rollback steps.
